newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end weaker, await auction.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end weaker, await auction.

text.p: Portuguese bonds ended weaker after a drop in U.S. Treasuries pulled down European bonds, and spreads against 10-year Bunds narrowed, dealers said.
Attention focused on tomrrow's 10-year bond auction and a meeting of the policy-making group of the Fed.

"Few players were willing to take positions at the end of the quarter. Tomorrow's FOMC meeting is inhibiting activity. No one knows what the Fed will do, and so players are sidelined," one operator said.
Dealers said spreads against 10-year Bunds would remain in a range between 65 and 70 basis points.
